separateProductionIncident.evidence: D1: COUNT(*)=22407 listed, SUM(LENGTH(record_json))=50865333; / 500 x3 via curl; /api/trending 500; /api/search vectorError verbatim; /search 200
separateProductionIncident.fixedInThisTask: catalogOwners (the dashboard/claims N+1: 1,075 sequential D1 calls vs the Workers 1,000-subrequest ceiling) — rewritten to one query; this unblocked the dashboard verification.
separateProductionIncident.mechanism: allRecords() (cf/src/db.ts) runs SELECT record_json FROM records WHERE status='listed' — a full-table load. Production D1 now holds 22,407 listed records totaling 50,865,333 bytes of record_json, just over D1's 50 MB single-query response limit. trendingRecords() calls allRecords() OUTSIDE its try/catch, so home and /api/trending throw. The search vector block and the post-rank fallback hit the same call. Home was 200 this morning at 16,096 records; the queue slice + sandbox drain pushed the catalog past the threshold during the day.
separateProductionIncident.notFixed: allRecords callers: trendingRecords (home, /api/trending), hybridSearch post-rank fallback, suggestForSkill. Fix shape: fetch only needed records by id for trending (trending ids + a bounded recent sample for the static fallback), bound the search fallback, page suggestForSkill. Needs its own build + gate.
separateProductionIncident.observed: Home / and /api/trending return 500 (serving the 404 page); /api/search returns 200 with vectorError 'D1 query result exceeded the maximum response size limit of 50 MB' and falls back to keyword-only.
